captured_from.role: ai-shared-lib canonical module (source of record; SC-MODELROSTER's argv note applies here)
the copy vendored into the delivery-agent-team plugin the live harness actually executes

cross_check_note: Dispatch-table command names (main()'s top-level switch + runFeedback's nested switch) are byte-for-byte identical between both baselines as of capture -- 29 top-level names plus feedback's 3 sub-verbs, verified by direct source diff and by a case-label regex extraction over each main.go independently (see capture.py). Two subcommands diverge in FLAG-LEVEL and EXIT-CODE substance, not in enumeration: self-check and record. Both diverge because M0's roster-tiering work (self-check) and M0.P8's writer fail-fast (record) landed on the canonical module but were never vendored into the plugin's embedded copy -- confirmed empirically below and recorded as a flagged, uncorrected finding, not silently reconciled. This fixture pins the CANONICAL (post-M0) shape as the frozen contract per SC-MODELROSTER's argv note; the plugin-embedded copy's pre-M0 shape is the divergence a future sync (or the frozen-API decomposition itself) must close.

baseline_divergences.finding: Canonical adds a --band NAME flag (roster-resolved band lookup) mutually exclusive with the four literal --floor-*/--ceiling-* flags, and a roster_stale JSON field + exit code 3. The plugin-embedded copy still requires the four literal flags unconditionally and has no --band flag, no roster_stale field, and no exit 3 -- passing --band to it is an unrecognized-flag usage error (exit 2).
baseline_divergences.verified: Empirically, both binaries built from their respective sources: canonical accepts `self-check --band bogus` (exits 2, unrecognized-band message); plugin-embedded rejects the same invocation with `flag provided but not defined: -band` (exit 2, different message, same code).

baseline_divergences.finding: Canonical refuses (exit 2, empty stdout) any write that would leave a task status=done with no commit SHA on the resulting row. The plugin-embedded copy still persists that write (exit 0, full execution.json on stdout) -- pre-M0.P8 behavior.
baseline_divergences.verified: Empirically, `record <exec> <id> --status done` with no --commit and none previously recorded: canonical exits 2 with 'status=done requires field "commit"'; plugin-embedded exits 0 and prints the updated execution.json with the task persisted done and no commit.

global_exit_code_legend.1: a command-specific business check failed (ok:false, abort, structural refusal, or off-surface/violation finding) — never a usage error
global_exit_code_legend.2: usage or IO error: missing/extra positional, unreadable or malformed input file, a required flag left empty, or a flag.FlagSet parse error (unrecognized flag / bad value) — this last case applies uniformly to every subcommand that defines flags, on top of the per-command exit_codes below
global_exit_code_legend.3: roster-stale (self-check only, canonical/post-M0 shape) — the observed session model or a band endpoint is absent from the model roster

Effort: $CLAUDE_EFFORT, fallback settings.json effortLevel; an undetectable effort degrades to a model-only band check (never a hard error). exit_codes.1: abort:true — below the floor, and/or (when the identity guard is requested) a session-id mismatch
exit_codes.2: canonical: neither/both of --band and the literal flag set given, or an unrecognized --band name; plugin-embedded: any of the four literal flags missing (no --band form exists); both: model undeterminable (transcript unreadable/model-less AND $ANTHROPIC_MODEL unset); with the identity guard requested: both/neither of --session-id/--scratchpad-path set, an unparseable/invalid session id or scratchpad path, --transcript missing, or --transcript unreadable/empty/all-malformed/naming no sessionId on any line
exit_codes.3: CANONICAL ONLY: roster-stale — the observed model or a band endpoint is absent from the model roster
